changes: Live Blackjack: removed the max buy-in limit entirely — tables now only set a minimum, buy in for as much as you want above that (up to your real XP balance, obviously).

Fixed real seating lag — sitting down or standing up used to wait entirely on the real-time listener to eventually pick up the change before the seat grid updated, which could take a noticeable moment. Now re-renders immediately for whoever just acted.

Chip rail expanded from 6 to 9 — added 5, 10, and 25 with their real values (the existing 6 were quietly repurposed with different values before; now every chip everywhere in the app means what it says), plus 3 new colours for 500/1K/2.5K.
